modules.name: My lil Arpeggio
modules.description: Dual quantizer and arpeggiator sharing one scale: 10 presets, an editable keyboard, and a scale-degree interval for in-key harmony

modules.name: My lil Ripple
modules.description: Polyrhythm trigger generator with an ADSR envelope: four period generators mixed on a grid or as summed waves into two complementary rhythms, with accent and clock outs, and an envelope out fired by the rhythm

modules.name: My lil Filter
modules.description: Acid 24 dB resonant low-pass for audio: drive, cutoff CV with amount, 1 V/oct key tracking, resonance CV, polyphonic

modules.name: My lil Slider
modules.description: Two 8-step slider sequencers with gate buttons: record CV and gates live, per-section length, range, invert and reverse, chain to 16 steps

modules.name: My lil Mixer
modules.description: Eight-strip stereo mixer with sidechain ducking: level, pan, two sends, duck amount, mute and solo per strip, two stereo returns, master soft clip; strip meters with duck bars, master LUFS and history

modules.name: My lil Acid Bass
modules.description: Acid bass voice (saw/square, resonant 24 dB filter, accent, slide) with a 32-step sequencer and 32 pattern slots

modules.name: My lil Acid Voice
modules.description: The acid bass voice on its own: V/Oct, gate, accent and slide in, cutoff and resonance CV, audio out

modules.name: My lil Looper
modules.description: Five-track stereo live looper: record, overdub with undo, reverse and one-shot per track, synced to the first loop or a clock

modules.name: My lil Drums
modules.description: FPC-style drum sequencer: 16 sample pads, 64-step piano roll, per-pad ADSR, filter and compressor, MIDI out

modules.name: My lil VJ Link
modules.description: Sends your patch's audio analysis to My Lil VJ and turns its levels, LFOs, camera motion, hand tracking and show events into CV
